compliance_notes: PAN numbers: RBI circular 2023-09 requires format-preserving tokenisation

All Restricted data requires DLP tool scan before prod load
student_judgment: Yes you should run LLM even when regex finds nothing as LLM is semantically more advanced and can figure out where regex fails. The cost vs risk tradeoff is that we can not send millions of rows to LLM as it would be extremely expensive but the regualtions have to be maintained as well. SSo a hybrid approach is better.
